title.ru: Сколько: some / any, much / many, a few / a little
title.en: Quantity: some / any, much / many, a few / a little

pattern.en: How many tickets do you need?

text.ru: Исчисляемые (можно посчитать: tickets, people) — many, a few, how many. Неисчисляемые (water, money, time, information, advice) — much, a little, how much, без -s и без a. some — в утверждениях и просьбах (Can I have some water?), any — в вопросах и отрицаниях. a lot of — «много» для любых, особенно в утверждениях.
text.en: Countable nouns: many, a few, how many. Uncountable (water, money, time, information, advice): much, a little, how much — no -s, no a. some in statements and offers, any in questions and negatives. a lot of works for both.
text.es: Contables: many, a few; incontables: much, a little. some (+) / any (−, ?). a lot of.

rule.formula: исчисляемые: many, a few · неисчисляемые: much, a little · some (+), any (−, ?) · a lot of — всё

note.ru: в испанском mucho согласуется: mucho tiempo, muchas preguntas

exercises.en: We don't have much time before the flight.
exercises.ru: До рейса у нас мало времени.

prompt.ru: Опишите свою неделю: чего много, а чего мало.
prompt.en: Describe your week: what there is a lot of and little of.
prompt.es: Describe tu semana: de qué hay mucho y de qué poco.

exercises.template: This week I have a lot of … and not much …
exercises.sample: This week I have a lot of meetings and not much free time.
